> ming_sim/db.py (1)
> > `6727-6756`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_ > > **Manpower delta of 0 can trigger an unauthorized arrears write-off.** > > The origin check at line 6731 is skipped when `delta == 0`: > ``` > origin_error = self.effect_origin_rejection(origin_ref) if require_origin and delta != 0 else None > ``` > But the arrears write-off block right after it (lines 6736-6756) fires based only on `new_value == 0` (plus owner/cutover/arrears conditions), not on `delta != 0`. If an army is already at zero manpower with outstanding arrears (for example, after the pay-source cutover migration) and the extractor sends `manpower: 0` for it (a no-op request), the write-off executes with no origin authorization, and the resulting `army_logs` row is stamped with whatever (possibly empty) `origin_ref` was passed in. > > Gate the write-off on the same origin check, not only on `delta != 0`. > > > >
> 🔒 Proposed fix to close the origin-check gap > > ```diff > elif field == "manpower": > delta = int(value) > new_value = max(0, int(old_value) + delta) > actual_delta = new_value - int(old_value) > - origin_error = self.effect_origin_rejection(origin_ref) if require_origin and delta != 0 else None > + triggers_arrears_writeoff = ( > + self.is_army_pay_source_cutover_enabled() > + and new_value == 0 > + and str(row["owner_power"]) == "ming" > + and float(row["arrears"] or 0) > 1e-9 > + ) > + origin_error = ( > + self.effect_origin_rejection(origin_ref) > + if require_origin and (delta != 0 or triggers_arrears_writeoff) > + else None > + ) > if origin_error: > changes.append({"army": row["name"], "field": field, **origin_error, > "item": {"army_id": army_id, "field": field, "value": value}}) > continue > - if ( > - self.is_army_pay_source_cutover_enabled() > - and new_value == 0 > - and str(row["owner_power"]) == "ming" > - and float(row["arrears"] or 0) > 1e-9 > - ): > + if triggers_arrears_writeoff: > old_arrears = float(row["arrears"] or 0) > ``` >
> >
> 🤖 Prompt for AI Agents > > ``` > Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the > rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. > > In `@ming_sim/db.py` around lines 6727 - 6756, Gate the arrears write-off block in > the manpower branch of the surrounding update method on successful origin > authorization as well as the existing cutover, zero-manpower, owner, and arrears > conditions. Ensure a no-op manpower delta cannot write off arrears without > passing the same origin check, while preserving the current behavior for > authorized nonzero changes. > ``` > >

> ming_sim/cli_backend.py (1)
> > `2124-2133`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_ > > **Shut down the confirmation executor on every exit path.** > > Line 2131 starts a worker, but `confirmation_pool.shutdown(...)` is reached only after `confirmation_future.result()` at Lines 2219-2229. If parsing, metadata normalization, or another operation before that block raises, `_extract_secret_order` can exit while the worker continues the LLM request. Put all code after `submit` inside an outer `try/finally` and close `confirmation_pool` from that `finally`. > > > > > > > > Also applies to: 2219-2229 > >

Wrap all work > after `confirmation_pool.submit(...)` in an outer try/finally and call > `confirmation_pool.shutdown(...)` from that finally, while preserving the > existing future-result handling. > ``` > >

That provider marks every reviewed dossier as `promulgated`. `GameSession.resolve_turn` calls `resolve_directives` without a provider, so the Web path bypasses adjudication. > > Pass a production LLM-backed provider from the Web path.
